facts.text: All full-time undergraduate students at Saint Louis University are required to live on campus for their first two years of study.

sources.title: Housing Options : SLU - Saint Louis University

facts.text: Under the Billiken Promise, all Saint Louis University undergraduates have the opportunity to study at the university's Madrid, Spain campus while retaining their scholarships and grants.

sources.title: The Billiken Promise : SLU - Saint Louis University
